items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The diff matches the reference line for line. `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):` is a small, clear guard that sits under the existing comment about managing the reverse relation by hand. Formatting matches the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It is a two-line change that reuses the existing field cache API (`is_cached`). No new bookkeeping was added. The agent experimented with edits to query.py and other places, but none of that remains in the final diff.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The fix only adds a conditional. No exceptions are swallowed and no magic constants are introduced. Existing behaviour is kept when nothing is cached (`instances_dict[rel_obj_attr(rel_obj)]` still runs in that case). Hidden tests pass: F2P 1/1, P2P 85/85.
